what_this_is: The detect stage of 424's transfer measurement rerun on the current code, with the current default detector (toxoplasma_well_detector_v2 = yolo_welldetect_v4.pt, sha256 f2a1e1110f09...) at the sizes the module ships (spacr.plaque_papers.DEFAULT_IMGSZ = 640, 1280), the two sizes merged by the module's own find_plaque_regions (the recorded boxes are replayed through it, so the merge measured is the shipped one). CPU only, GPU hidden. Nothing was relabelled: the region counts are the 2026-09-19 reader's 369, and the box verdicts carried here are the 2026-09-20 reader's, carried only where the merged boxes ARE the boxes that reader judged.
spacr_from: the worktree the harness was run in (PYTHONPATH), recorded in each run's detections.json
ultralytics: 8.4.157, from the spacr conda env; YOLO_CONFIG_DIR inside the run directory

instrument_checks.corpus: papers.json rebuilt from the 2026-09-20 evidence; figures refetched from Europe PMC; 182 of 182 byte-identical to the committed sha256 (129/129 arm A, 53/53 arm B)
instrument_checks.detector: sha256 f2a1e1110f09 as in the 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-20 records
instrument_checks.boxes_at_640: 148, and the 640 box set is coordinate-identical to the committed 2026-09-20 rerun on 182 of 182 figures
instrument_checks.seconds: 796 + 409 on a machine at load average ~90 from other jobs; the 2026-09-20 runs took ~35 s at one size, so the time is contention, not the method

A_open_access_plaque_assays.merge: spacr.plaque_papers.find_plaque_regions: every size asked, a box overlapping a kept one at IoU > 0.5 is the same region, the higher score kept and both sizes recorded

B_toxoplasma_only.merge: spacr.plaque_papers.find_plaque_regions: every size asked, a box overlapping a kept one at IoU > 0.5 is the same region, the higher score kept and both sizes recorded

result.what_is_mechanical: A merged box that is also a 640 box (same region, IoU > 0.5) carries the 2026-09-20 verdict. A box on a figure with no region is false by the protocol. A box on a figure whose regions the 640 boxes had ALL already claimed cannot be a true positive; it is a duplicate or false, and counts against precision either way.
result.wells_found: 61/259, 61/67 without the 192-well plate figure -- unchanged: every well figure's merged boxes are its 640 boxes
result.crops_found_lower_bound: 63/110 -- the 640 finds are all kept; the merge loses none of the faint whole panels 1280 alone loses (PMC9744290 g004 6/6, g006 4/4, g007 4/4, PMC13309054 g003 1)
result.crops_found_upper_bound: 106/110 -- if every 1280-only box on the three lawn-strip figures fell on a different strip
result.crops_found_as_the_2026_09_20_reader_saw: about 80/110: the lawn-strip figures' merged boxes are their 1280 boxes (28 of Fig1's 29 after the merge folds two, 14 and 11), and that reader's 1280 look put a box on about 9 of 30, 4 of 8 and 4 of 5 strips. Approximate because it was a count of strips carrying a box, made by clustering box centres, not a region-by-region verdict.
result.false_boxes_on_no_region_figures: 16 on 5 figures, against 15 at 640 and 12 at 1280: the merge keeps the union -- the 10 Listeria motility plates, 2 electron-micrograph boxes, 2 brightfield monolayer boxes, the flowchart box, and the 1280-only cartoon virion (PMC12930041 fx1)

new_boxes_that_cannot_be_true_positives.PMC13170237 mbio.03124-25 f001: 2 boxes found only at 1280, zero overlap with any other box, on a figure whose 4 crops the 640 boxes already claim; the overlay shows them on the 'client protein' cartoons of panel A -- false boxes on a schematic
new_boxes_that_cannot_be_true_positives.PMC13279940 Fig4: 2 boxes found only at 1280, on a figure whose 6 regions the 640 boxes already claim; on the overlay they sit on dilution spots of rows already boxed, which the protocol counts as duplicates

result.precision: tp is 124 known + the lawn strips; boxes 206. Bounds 124/206 = 0.602 to 167/206 = 0.811; about 141/206 = 0.684 with the 2026-09-20 reader's ~17 strips. At 640 alone it was 124/148 = 0.838. Most of the drop is the protocol counting a strip as one region while the merged detector boxes each dilution spot: of the 53 lawn-strip boxes about 36 are further spots on a strip already claimed. Whether a spot or a strip is the unit a measurement wants is a definition question the protocol answered for strips; for plaque counting per dilution the spot is arguably the unit.
result.macro_recall_24_figures: 0.670 at 640; about 0.737 merged with the approximate strip counts (the three lawn figures go from 0 to ~0.30, 0.50, 0.80)

what_a_person_must_still_check: The three lawn-strip figures (PMC13279940 Fig1, Fig2, Fig3) on the merged overlays: which strips carry a box, and which boxes are further spots on a claimed strip. This is the only thing between the bounds above and a number.
PMC13279940 Fig4's two 1280-only boxes: duplicate (spot in a claimed row) or false.
The region counts themselves: still ONE reader (2026-09-19), counted with boxes visible; no second reader has checked them, and nothing in this run did.
Nothing here samples crop-bearing figures on purpose; 10 crop figures, 38 of 110 crops in one of them.
gpu_training: NOT justified by this measurement. The queued 424a job (a two-class detector trained on 300-600 newly annotated figures) was written to cure a crop blindness that does not exist; at the shipped sizes the merged detector keeps every 640 find and adds most of the lawn-strip form. What it costs is precision on schematics and per-spot duplicates, which a training round on crops would not address.
